reviews.title: Nothing is better than CoinGecko... yet...
reviews.pros: I absolutely love how easy it is to track my crypto when it's located in a bunch of different places. It's so easy to check my portfolio and see my balance.
reviews.cons: I don't like that it doesn't yet offer integrations directly with Crypto Trading platforms and wallets, so that it will update my balances automatically instead of me having to go in and manually do it. But I understand why it can't as they're dealing with highly sensitive information.
reviews.overall: I wish it had some additional features, but those aren't currently available so it is the best solution on the market currently for tracking crypto.
